notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-terminal-eoc (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): EOC on an LUTYPE2 terminal's RECEIVE: by RESP, by HANDLE CONDITION, and ignored by default. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: eoc-resp
scenarios.why: RESP(WS-RESP): the RECEIVE returns EOC (6), no transfer

scenarios.name: eoc-handled
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION EOC(GOT-EOC): control goes to the label after the data and LENGTH are set

scenarios.name: eoc-default
scenarios.why: neither RESP nor a handler: EOC's default action is to ignore it; the program goes on, EIBRESP 6
